body: ## Stockstoearn's Post. ### **Stockstoearn**. BREAKING: Broadcom (AVGO) shares plunge more than 14% in pre-market, erasing over $310 billion in market value following the company's fiscal Q2 earnings report. While the company technically beat top and bottom-line estimates, it disappointed high market expectations by:. • Keeping its fiscal year AI revenue forecast flat at $100 billion instead of raising it. • Issuing below-consensus FQ3 AI semiconductor revenue guidance ($16 billion vs. the $17.2 billion Wall Street expected). Shares of AI chip winners, including Marvell (MRVL), Nvidia (NVDA), and AMD (AMD), fell in premarket trading after Broadcom did not raise its AI semiconductor sales forecast for 2026. Marvell Technology (MRVL) is down over 6%, Micron (MU) is down over 7%, Intel (INTC) is down 6%, SanDisk (SNDK) is down over 5% and so on.
